located_bottleneck.name: CERTIFIED_RESIDUAL_QUOTIENT_COMPLEXITY
located_bottleneck.definition: For a decomposition/order, the total number of exact residual function classes plus the proof volume needed to certify every state merge, transition, terminal, and witness-recovery map.

two_independent_costs.state_volume: The number of continuation-distinct residual Boolean functions.
two_independent_costs.merge_proof_volume: The certificates establishing equivalence of syntactically different residual representations.

why_it_is_exact: Blocked equality forces 2^n continuation-distinct states at one cut, so no exact deterministic message can merge them.
The absorption family has 2^n raw residual CNFs but one semantic state, and polynomial subsumption proofs certify the collapse.
General semantic merging is coNP-hard because F can merge with FALSE exactly when F is UNSAT.

theorem_candidate.name: Certified Residual Automaton Criterion
theorem_candidate.statement: If every CNF F admits a polynomial-size residual automaton whose variable/decomposition transitions, state equivalences, terminals, and witness recovery are independently verifiable in polynomial time, and such an automaton is constructible in polynomial time, then SAT is in P.

what_improved: The nonlinear quotient core was refined into a canonical separator-state object rather than a vague hard remainder.
Representation explosion and proof-of-equivalence cost are now measured separately.
A real exponential fake width was removed by polynomial certificates, while a genuine exponential continuation width was detected and refused.
distance_to_p_equals_np.next_exact_target: Construct a polynomially discoverable order/decomposition and a polynomial proof system for all necessary residual merges on every CNF, or identify an invariant forcing superpolynomial certified residual quotient complexity for a restricted proof architecture.

claim_boundary: C025 does not prove P=NP, P!=NP, or a lower bound against all algorithms. It constructs one honest proof-carrying residual compiler, isolates the equivalence-certificate barrier, and attacks it on exact finite and symbolic families.
